basics.name: Usama Fouad
basics.label: iOS Developer
basics.headline: I build polished iOS apps that feel native, because they are.
basics.summary: Software engineer and iOS developer at VOIS, and a Top Rated freelancer on Upwork. I build native apps in Swift, SwiftUI and UIKit. At Nugttah I led the iOS app, grew App Store reviews from 120 to 6,000 and lifted the rating from 4.3 to 4.8. I'm a Computers & Artificial Intelligence graduate of Cairo University with a strong foundation in algorithms, design patterns and software architecture.
